subject: Pollinators
fact: Many flowering plants rely on animals such as bees, butterflies, moths, and birds to move pollen between flowers.
source: U.S. Forest Service, Pollinators and Their Habitats

subject: Leaves
fact: Leaves appear green because chlorophyll absorbs much of the red and blue light used in photosynthesis and reflects more green light.

subject: Urban nature
fact: Even small urban green spaces can provide food, shelter, and movement corridors for wildlife.
source: U.S. National Park Service, Urban Ecology

subject: Observation
fact: Keeping a field journal helps turn fleeting observations into questions that can be revisited over time.
